title: Test Engineer
description:
Minimum qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, and 3 years of experience in the job offered or in a Test Engineer-related occupation.
  • Position requires 3 years of experience in the following: Developing test methodologies, writing test plans, creating test cases, or defining and documenting test strategy for various RF technologies including cellular, WiFi, BT, and UWB on both MLB and OTA levels for consumer hardware; Analyzing systems architecture and applying systems thinking to decompose systems into testable components; Applying knowledge of the product development lifecycle to software testing, firmware testing, and hardware performance validation; Designing, writing, testing, and maintaining software applications using one or more programming languages; and Utilizing test automation tools or creating and using test automation frameworks to set up test functions and evaluate outcomes.

About The Job

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $201,100 - $218,000 + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Learn more about benefits at Google .

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and use of automation tools and scripts to improve product health and engineering efficiency;
  • Develop comprehensive test plans based on product strategies and lead review sessions with cross-functional teams;
  • Define and promote new test frameworks, preconditions, and reporting functions to enable effective functionality testing;
  • Drive initiatives to create new or improve existing test infrastructure for increased productivity in test development and deployment;
  • Influence product design and the release cycle by participating in design reviews and contributing to code quality; and Analyze test outcomes, debug failures, and synthesize data into actionable insights for engineering and product stakeholders. International Travel Required


Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Cardstream is a market-leading fintech providing secure, scalable payment technology and infrastructure to partners across the payments ecosystem. Trusted by acquirers, ISVs, SaaS platforms, and payment providers, Cardstream enables businesses to build, scale, and operate sophisticated payment propositions with confidence.


We are looking for a proactive Software Quality Assurance Engineer to help ensure the reliability, security, and performance of Cardstream’s payment platform. This is an opportunity to play a defining role in the quality of ground-breaking payment technology used at scale. Your work will directly influence how new features are delivered, how risks are surfaced early, and how quality is designed into products from the start, not inspected in, at the end.   • Collaborating with software engineers and product managers to support root cause analysis, debugging, and continuous improvement.
  • Helping define, evolve, and embed QA best practices across teams, tools, and processes.

Required

  • An understanding of JavaScript and how it applies to test automation.
  • Working knowledge of Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) and writing meaningful, readable test scenarios.
  • Strong test analysis, preparation, and execution skills across the full testing lifecycle.
  • Ability to break down requirements to user-story level and identifying edge cases and risk areas.
  • A pragmatic, detail-driven mindset with the ability to balance quality with delivery.

Desirable

  • The opportunity to influence testing strategy and quality standards across a growing payment suite.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Ongoing learning, development, and the chance to deepen your expertise in payments and FinTech.

Home Assistant OS is an open-source project stewarded by the Open Home Foundation. Nabu Casa develops and ships hardware products that run Home Assistant OS and contributes engineering effort to ensure those devices remain reliable, performant, secure, and well-supported throughout their lifecycle.

The Role

This is a hands-on, technical position where you’ll take ownership of product testing across the entire development lifecycle. You will be a key member of our New Product Development team, working closely with Mechanical and Design engineers testing products throughout verification — from concept, through development, to production and beyond. You will also carry out structured testing of competitor products to benchmark performances ensuring our products exceed category‑leading standards and identify strengths and weaknesses in the market.


This is an on-site role, working 5 days per week from our office in Broxburn, West Lothian.


What you’ll do

  • Testing & Verification: Own, execute, and evolve test plans — pushing products to their limits to uncover issues early. You’ll be asked to test, break, learn, fix, repeat… and repeat again. You’ll embody our value of rigour every day.

  • Continuous Learning: Learn from and be supported by our excellent team, with opportunities to grow your technical and practical testing capability.


And of course… eat a LOT of pizza.

This role is ideal for a technical, detail-oriented engineer who enjoys solving tough problems, thrives on testing and iteration, and brings a structured, methodical approach to documentation.   • Confidence working with machine shop tools.

Why Ooni?
